title: author
description: Reference dimension — one community account (Phase 4 trust dimension). See data-dictionary.md §1.2 and data-model.md §5.1.

username.description: Account handle. Natural key. Today authors are bare strings on events.

account_created.description: Account age basis for author_cred/astroturf. Reddit via Arctic-Shift user data; Discord via join date.

karma.description: Reddit karma (Discord has no analog → null).

author_cred.description: Tenure/karma-derived credibility weight. Down-weights brand-new accounts. 0 = untrusted, 1 = established.

is_bot.description: Known bot/automation (AutoModerator, VisualMod, wsbapp, …). Filtered at ingestion (config list today).

first_seen.description: When this account was first observed (bookkeeping).

last_seen.description: When this account was last observed (bookkeeping).
